# Tidepool Landing Page: Build Plan

**Overall direction:** Calm, tactile, and organized, like a tide chart. Warm off-white backgrounds, one deep teal for anchoring, one coral accent for action. Avoid corporate-blue SaaS clichés.

**Palette:** Sand `#F5EFE6` (background), Deep Teal `#0F3D3E` (text, nav, dark sections), Seafoam `#7FD1B9` (highlights, tags), Coral `#FF7A59` (primary CTAs only).

**Type:** Fraunces (serif) for headlines, Inter for body and UI labels. Headlines at 56px desktop, body at 18px with 1.6 line height.

---

**1. Navigation**
Single row, logo left, three links (Product, Pricing, Stories), "Start free" button right. Sticky on scroll with sand background and a thin bottom border.

**2. Hero**
Two columns: left 55%, right 45%. Headline: "Plan your week together, without the meeting." Subhead names the pain: a shared view of who's doing what, when. Coral primary CTA ("Start a week, free") with a text link ("See how it works"). Right side: an illustrated, flat-style weekly board with three teammate avatars moving sticky notes. Copy tone: plain, warm, short sentences.

**3. Logo Strip**
Four to six small-team customer names in grayscale on sand. Caption: "Trusted by teams of 3 to 12." No stock imagery.

**4. Problem Statement**
Full-width deep teal band. Three short statements in Fraunces at 32px: "Monday planning eats an hour." "Priorities live in five chat threads." "Someone always finds out late." Copy stays blunt and specific.

**5. How It Works**
Three horizontal steps with numbered seafoam circles. Each step gets a one-line verb heading: Gather, Sequence, Sync. Each has two sentences of body copy and a small illustrated icon. Layout collapses to vertical on mobile.

**6. Product Preview**
Large screenshot of the actual board, slightly tilted with a soft shadow. Three callouts with thin coral leader lines pointing to features: drag-to-reschedule, shared focus blocks, end-of-week recap. Copy describes what users do, not what the feature is called.

**7. Testimonials**
Three cards on white. Each: one quote under 30 words, name, role, team size. Use real photos at small size, not stock.

**8. Pricing**
Two tiers, side by side. Free (up to 4 people) and Team (flat monthly). Recommended tier gets a seafoam border and "Most small teams" tag. Monthly/annual toggle above.

**9. FAQ**
Accordion, six questions. Include "Do we all need to sign up?" and "Can we export our plans?"

**10. Final CTA**
Full-bleed teal section with centered Fraunces headline: "Your next Monday starts with a shared week." One coral button, email field optional.

**11. Footer**
Four columns (Product, Company, Resources, Legal) on sand. Small wordmark and a tide-line illustration as a divider.

# Tidepool Landing Page: Revised Build Plan

**What changed and why**

- **Hero headline stays short.** The Library example runs over 40 words, and a visitor can't absorb it before scrolling. Tidepool's headline is eight words, and the subhead carries the detail.
- **The week timeline becomes the product's spine.** A vertical day rail (Mon to Sun) runs through the hero, How It Works, and the product preview, so the page reads like the planning tool itself.
- **A hand-drawn annotation adds the tactile feel** the brief asks for, but it points at one thing only.
- **Monospace goes to data, not decoration.** It labels timestamps and team sizes in quotes, which suits a planning tool.
- **Palette stays Tidepool's.** Sand, deep teal, seafoam, and coral. Forest green would blur our brand next to the Library example, so we keep teal.

**Overall direction:** Calm, tactile, organized, like a tide chart. Warm off-white, one anchoring teal, one coral for action only.

**Type:** Fraunces for headlines (56px desktop, 36px mobile), Inter for body (18px, 1.6 line height), JetBrains Mono for timestamps, quote metadata, and team-size labels (14px).

---

**1. Navigation**
Logo left, links (Product, Pricing, Stories), "Start free" button right. Sticky on scroll, sand background, thin bottom border. Mobile: logo and menu icon only.

**2. Hero**
Two columns, 52% text and 48% visual. Headline: "Plan your week together, without the meeting." Subhead, under 20 words: "A shared view of who's doing what, when, for teams of three to twelve." Coral CTA "Start a week, free," with a text link "See how it works."
Right side: the board screenshot sits beside a vertical day rail with seven nodes, Mon through Sun, where today is filled seafoam. A hand-drawn coral arrow runs from the headline to the board with the handwritten-style note "Everyone's week, one view." Use one arrow only.

**3. Logo Strip**
Five to six customer names in grayscale on sand. Caption: "Trusted by teams of 3 to 12." No stock imagery.

**4. Problem Statement**
Full-width deep teal band. Three Fraunces statements at 32px, each on its own line: "Monday planning eats an hour." "Priorities live in five chat threads." "Someone always finds out late." Each line fades in on scroll, one at a time.

**5. How It Works**
The vertical day rail returns as the spine, running down the left edge. Three steps attach to nodes on the rail: Gather (Monday), Sequence (Tuesday), Sync (Friday). Each step has a verb heading, two sentences of body copy, and a small flat icon. Desktop shows the rail on the left with steps to the right. Mobile keeps the rail as a thin line with steps stacked along it.

**6. Product Preview**
Large screenshot of the real board, slightly tilted with a soft shadow. Three callouts with thin coral leader lines: drag to reschedule, shared focus blocks, Friday recap. Copy describes actions ("Move a task to Thursday and everyone sees it instantly"), not feature names.

**7. Testimonials**
One featured pull quote, set in JetBrains Mono on a white card, under 30 words. Below it, two smaller cards with Inter quotes. Each card shows a real customer photo at small size, name, role, and a mono label such as "Team of 5 · Planning weekly since March."

**8. Pricing**
Two tiers side by side. Free covers up to four people. Team is a flat monthly price with no per-seat math. The Team card gets a seafoam border and a "Most small teams" tag. Monthly/annual toggle above the cards, with the annual savings shown in seafoam.

**9. FAQ**
Accordion with six questions. Required entries:
- "Do we all need to sign up?" Answer: Only the person who creates the week. Others join with a link.
- "Can we export our plans?" Answer: Yes, to CSV or a shared PDF, any time.
- "Does it work with our calendar?" Answer: Yes, with Google Calendar and Outlook.

**10. Final CTA**
Full-bleed teal section with a centered Fraunces headline: "Your next Monday starts with a shared week." One coral button, "Start a week, free." Drop the optional email field, since a single button lowers friction.

**11. Footer**
Four columns (Product, Company, Resources, Legal) on sand. Small wordmark at left. A tide-line SVG divides the footer from the CTA. Mobile: columns collapse to accordions.
